scope: Static helper/mock/SDK review plus12 independent pure mocks. No real PID observation or signal; native process and kill functions are mocked. Ordinary temporary-file fgetattrlist only.
qualified_action: No PID argument: daemon PID comes only from one strict READY event associated with the exact fixedF99 driver wrapper/result/log.
Root euid, bounded ordinary nlink1 NOFOLLOW files, exact driver/runtime SHA, strict JSON duplicate/NaN rejection and byte/metadata/birthtime rechecks are required.

Driver command is exactly sudo or /usr/bin/sudo -n /usr/bin/python3 fixeddriver --run. Exactscope is fixedV4 binary hash/CDHash, paths=[], allow_allfalse, no persistentconfig; precisely two matching hooks and successful stopped-state breakpoint deletion/DetachFalse/CLEANUP_DONE are required.
Native process info reads PROC_PIDTBSDINFO twice around proc_pidpath, rejects short/path/identity change and correct TRACE bit2 in both reads.

Native identity must be READYpid, /usr/libexec/amfid, UID0, PPID1; positive valid start time must satisfy start_ns<=original driver log birth_ns. This direction rejects a later process reusing the PID; a process starting after log creation is conservatively refused.
Before action all source/evidence blobs are re-read for exact dataclass equality, then final native identity/state is checked again. A traced/gone/reused/changed daemon causes failure without signal.

Already SRUN2 emits no signal. Only SSTOP4 with xstatusSIGSTOP17 qualifies for a single SIGCONT; no Stop, debugger/attach, new hash/allowlist, process termination or persistent configuration API exists.

After one attempted SIGCONT, at most20 native observations with0.05s waits require same identity and SRUN2. Still stopped, traced, changed or gone fails without another signal. attempted/sent distinctions are preserved.
Exclusive NOFOLLOW mode0600 result is acquired before restore, written/fsynced with passedfalse errors and exit1 on failure; existing output refuses before any qualification/action.

limits: No live helper run or actual same-daemon SRUN restoration is established by these mocks. Later real invocation must produce its own successful qualified record.
Start/birthtime and before/final/after checks reduce PID reuse risk; PID-based observation and kill are separate syscalls, not an atomic process-handle transaction.
SRUN here means native status2, not proof that the process is consuming CPU or that host preflight/VM boot succeeds.
The helper restores this fixed-driver attached daemon only; it cannot authorize another pause, attach, hash or different VM. VM selection itself remains the formal fixedV4 task8-copy launch argv.
Why successful DetachFalse previously left native SSTOP remains unknown. No fixedF99 or V9 production change is made.
